_comment: Project-local Hive agent config for PipePusher. Overrides ~/.config/opencode/agent_hive.json. Controls which model each Hive role uses. Edit here to tune cost vs quality per role.

hive-master._comment: Orchestrator: plans, dispatches tasks, monitors DAG. Using Gemini 3.1 Pro for stronger DAG reasoning and plan quality.

scout-researcher._comment: Read-only exploration: grep, read files, research codebase. Cheap — Flash is enough.

forager-worker._comment: Implementation worker: writes code, runs tests, commits. Low temperature for determinism. Upgrade to Pro if tasks are failing due to reasoning quality.

hygienic-reviewer._comment: Code reviewer: catches bugs, invariant violations, style issues. Flash is sufficient for most reviews; swap to claude-sonnet for deep architectural review.
